title: Uniform Artin--Rees bound for reduced linear kernel images
statement:
theorem adic_kernel_image_bound {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {N : Type w} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Finite R N]
    (I : Ideal R) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ (l m : ℕ), m + c ≤ l →
      ((I ^ (l + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule R N)).comap f).map
          (I ^ (m + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule R M)).mkQ =
        f.ker.map (I ^ (m + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule R M)).mkQ

source.place: Lemma 087X, proof of claim (a); Lemma 087W for affine comparison

proof.text: Apply Ideal.exists_pow_inf_eq_pow_smul to range(f) inside the finite module N; choose c.

For x with f(x) in I^(l+1)N use the range intersection formula and map_smul to lift f(x) to y in I^(l+1-c)M. The inequality l >= m+c gives y in I^(m+1)M. The element x-y is in ker(f) and has the same quotient class. Conversely ker(f) lies in every preimage. Prove equality by these inclusions.
